mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT status FROM incident WHERE id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} LIMIT 1) AS incident_status, (SELECT id FROM operational_period WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1) AS current_op_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_assignment WHERE account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL) AS active_assignment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_assignment WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL) AS active_incident_assignment_count, (SELECT ds.id FROM duty_shift ds JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.id = ds.incident_assignment_id WHERE ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL AND ds.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ds.started_at DESC, ds.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS active_duty_shift_id
